# 2-Week Junior Data Analyst Interview Prep for Dublin

You have a solid base already: 1 year of experience, Excel, SQL basics, and 90 minutes per day is enough to build a focused, realistic prep plan. This schedule balances technical practice, analytics thinking, and interview communication for **2026-05-04 to 2026-05-17**.

## 2-Week Preparation Schedule

| Date | Focus | 90-Minute Plan | Goal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-04 | Role + CV alignment | Review job description; map 5 achievements; draft 60-second intro | Clear positioning |
| 2026-05-05 | Excel refresh | SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, XLOOKUP, pivots; 3 short practice tasks | Faster spreadsheet work |
| 2026-05-06 | SQL basics I | SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, HAVING; 10 query drills | Clean query fundamentals |
| 2026-05-07 | SQL basics II | JOINs, aliases, NULL handling; 5 join exercises | Confident joins |
| 2026-05-08 | Analytics thinking | Metrics, KPIs, funnels, trend analysis; explain 2 business cases | Stronger business framing |
| 2026-05-09 | Excel + SQL mixed practice | Solve 2 mini problems using both tools; review mistakes | Tool choice discipline |
| 2026-05-10 | Behavioral stories | Prepare 5 STAR stories: teamwork, challenge, mistake, learning, priority handling | Ready for common questions |
| 2026-05-11 | Data cleaning + quality | Missing values, duplicates, outliers, consistency checks | Show practical judgment |
| 2026-05-12 | SQL intermediate | CASE WHEN, subqueries, CTE basics; 5 timed questions | Better problem-solving |
| 2026-05-13 | Dashboard/reporting | Practice explaining charts, trends, and recommendations from sample data | Clear insights delivery |
| 2026-05-14 | Mock interview 1 | 30 min technical Qs + 30 min behavioral + 30 min review | Identify weak spots |
| 2026-05-15 | Weak-area repair | Rework missed SQL/Excel questions; tighten STAR answers | Close gaps |
| 2026-05-16 | Mock interview 2 | Full timed run: intro, technical, behavioral, questions for interviewer | Build confidence |
| 2026-05-17 | Final review | Light revision; prepare questions to ask; rest and confidence check | Be interview-ready |

## Likely Junior Data Analyst Interview Topics

- **Excel**
  - Pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, charts, data cleaning
- **SQL**
  - SELECT, JOINs, GROUP BY, HAVING, CASE WHEN, subqueries, CTE basics
- **Data quality**
  - Missing data, duplicates, anomalies, validation checks
- **Analytics**
  - KPIs, trends, segmentation, funnel analysis, basic A/B thinking
- **Business communication**
  - Turning data into recommendations, explaining findings simply
- **Behavioral questions**
  - Teamwork, handling pressure, learning quickly, fixing mistakes
- **Stakeholder support**
  - Prioritizing requests, clarifying ambiguous asks, managing deadlines
- **Tools and workflow**
  - Excel, SQL, dashboards, documentation, version control habits if relevant
- **Role fit**
  - Why this company, why Dublin, why data analysis, career goals
- **Practical scenarios**
  - “How would you investigate a drop in sales?” or “What would you do if data looks inconsistent?”

## Mock Interviewer Message You Can Send

Hi [Interviewer Name],

Thank you for the opportunity to interview for the Junior Data Analyst role. I’m looking forward to speaking with you.

Could you please confirm the interview date, time, and format so I can make sure I’m available? If there is anything specific I should prepare in advance, I’d be glad to review it.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Download prep plan](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/r)
Action: [Button: Practice SQL](https://www.w3schools.com/sql/)
Action: [Button: Excel refresher](https://support.microsoft.com/excel)
Action: [Button: Interview tips](https://www.themuse.com/advice/interview-questions-and-answers)

## Sources

- Microsoft Excel support: https://support.microsoft.com/excel
- W3Schools SQL tutorial: https://www.w3schools.com/sql/
- The Muse interview guide: https://www.themuse.com/advice/interview-questions-and-answers
